limitation_text: Manual contact and distance rows exercise the normalization schema only; they are not experimental folding targets.
PDB/mmCIF rows identify experimental target records and hash their locator-normalization rows; no archive coordinate payload is committed in this release.
AlphaFold rows are predicted-structure comparator targets, not experimental ground truth and not raw AFC/D.E.C. premises.
Target coordinates, contact maps, distance matrices, and secondary-structure labels are excluded from raw D.E.C. rows and future AOD prediction-freeze inputs.
